title: Network is $299 plus $59 a chapter, three at the least, and a Collective includes three Spaces
detail: Owner rulings 2026-10-21 (Pricing structure analysis thread): Network base $299 plus $59 a chapter, three chapters at the least (real minimum $476), chosen over $299 with three included; Collective includes three member Spaces. New live Stripe prices 2026-10-21: network base month price_1UT3VIPhyalyRPP1avzW5ll0 ($476), year price_1UT3VKPhyalyRPP1DWdo0tkJ ($4,760), nonprofit month price_1UT3VNPhyalyRPP1KvQ2MlPU ($380), year price_1UT3WDPhyalyRPP1xOyalPOi ($3,800); chapter prices unchanged. Migration 20270346022500 repoints pricing_stripe_prices and sets three included Spaces for a Collective; apply before merge. Old $326 and $260 prices (price_1USlPE.., price_1USlPQ.., price_1USlPY.., price_1USlPt..) archive after merge. See ADR-1817.
